plates.reference: Own code graphic: on period paper, an inked two-part mass-balance diagram of Lavoisier's 12-day swan-neck retort shows 4 oz mercury in 50 cubic inches of air losing 8–9 cubic inches (~1/5th) as 45 grains of red oxide gain 3.5 grains, then heating yields 41.5 grains mercury + 3.5 grains (8–9 in³) pure oxygen.
